targets.name: The Deception, 04:00 to 07:00: Napoleon has given up the plateau and left his right thin. The Allies form to attack it.
The Allied Advance, 07:00 to 08:45: Four columns go down into the Goldbach villages. The centre of the Allied position empties behind them.
The Pratzen Strike, 08:45 to 10:30: Soult climbs out of the fog onto ground the Allies have just left, and holds it against everything sent back.
The Army Divided, 10:30 to 12:45: With the plateau lost the Allied army is in two halves. The last reserve is spent trying to take it back.
The Collapse, 12:45 to 18:00: The French centre turns south onto the rear of an Allied left that is still attacking westward.
